title: Stop Negotiating With Sin
devotional: One of the easiest ways to lose a battle is to keep negotiating with something you already know is pulling you in the wrong direction. You tell yourself that you can get close without going too far, look without acting, stay for only a few minutes, or make one exception. But temptation becomes stronger when you keep giving it room to argue with you. Jesus used strong language to teach His followers to take serious action against what leads them into sin. Today, don't spend all your energy debating the temptation. Recognize it, make the necessary boundary, and move.
mind_check: What excuse do you usually give yourself when you know it is time to walk away?
body_move: When you recognize a situation is leading you toward temptation, leave instead of staying to negotiate with yourself.
spirit_move: Ask God for the courage to obey quickly. Read Matthew 5:29-30 and consider what practical boundary you need to take seriously.
way_out: When I recognize that I am beginning to negotiate with temptation, I will __________.
prayer: Father, give me courage to stop making excuses for choices that pull me away from You. Help me recognize when I am negotiating instead of obeying. Give me strength to create boundaries and follow through with them. Teach me to choose obedience quickly. Amen.
action: Write down one excuse you commonly use when you are tempted. Then write a short response you will give yourself the next time that excuse appears.
